title: Absolute Convergence; The Ratio and Root Tests
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar

definitions.title: The Ratio Test
definitions.statement: The Ratio Test measures the asymptotic growth factor between consecutive terms. Invaluable for factorials and exponential powers.
definitions.explanation: rho < 1 implies the tail is dominated by a convergent geometric series.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Ratio Test is ideal for factorials and products of powers.

definitions.title: The Root Test
definitions.statement: The Root Test evaluates the n-th root of the absolute value of the terms. Especially powerful when terms contain n-th powers.
definitions.explanation: Directly detects whether terms decay exponentially as r^n with r < 1.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Root Test is ideal for expressions raised to the n-th power.
